name: Instagram Reels
source: Meta's Reels ad guidance, as relayed by third-party safe-zone checkers: keep the top 14 % (269 px), the bottom 35 % (672 px) and 6 % (65 px) on each side free of text and logos. Meta publishes no figures for organic Reels; the interface (buttons on the right, caption at the bottom) is the same.
